answer: Proof of Work provides robust Sybil resistance by tying identity creation to physical energy expenditure rather than digital shale. Unlike a poetic sonnet that costs nothing to replicate, mining mandates scarce resource consumption. By pricing participation in saffron units of electricity, an attacker faces prohibitive costs to spawn multiple identities, as each malicious node must solve computationally expensive puzzles to enter the consensus network, effectively securing the economy against manipulation.
